experiences.name: Prague Castle Complex Tour
experiences.description: Explore the largest ancient castle complex in the world, including St. Vitus Cathedral, the Old Royal Palace, and Golden Lane. Wander through centuries of Bohemian history with stunning panoramic views over Prague's red-rooftop skyline.

experiences.name: Budapest Thermal Bath Experience at Széchenyi
experiences.description: Soak in one of Europe's largest and most iconic thermal bath complexes, built in 1913 in stunning Neo-Baroque style. Enjoy indoor and outdoor pools fed by natural hot springs, a beloved Budapest tradition blending wellness with architectural grandeur.

experiences.name: Old Town Prague Walking History Tour
experiences.description: Join a guided walking tour through Prague's UNESCO-listed Old Town, visiting the Astronomical Clock, Týn Church, and the Jewish Quarter (Josefov). Uncover medieval legends, Gothic architecture, and the rich multicultural history of Bohemia.

experiences.name: Buda Castle & Castle Hill Exploration
experiences.description: Discover the historic Buda Castle district, a UNESCO World Heritage Site perched above the Danube. Visit Matthias Church, Fisherman's Bastion with its fairy-tale turrets, and enjoy sweeping views over Pest and the iconic Chain Bridge below.

experiences.name: Danube River Evening Cruise
experiences.description: Glide along the Danube at dusk on a scenic river cruise passing illuminated landmarks including the Hungarian Parliament Building, Buda Castle, and the Chain Bridge. A breathtaking way to appreciate Budapest's architectural splendor from the water.
